text:
anya: Happy almost-holiday everyone! thought it'd be fun — drop a pic of your coziest mug and say which timezone you're in. i'll kick things off. ☕️🌲

devon: london GMT — tiny mug, massive tea. cheers! :tea:

sam: PST (SF) — peppermint mocha in a travel mug. office cat photobomb incoming later. :cat:

marta: CET — i'm in for a 3pm virtual toast. will anyone be doing a tiny snack exchange?

li: SGT — on call schedule means i'll be low-key sipping instant coffee but i will post the mug. also, can we do a quick poll: cookie or biscotti? :cookie::biscotti:

anya: vote with reactions! :thumbsup: cookie, :heart: biscotti. i'll count at 2pm GMT.

ops-bot: Reminder: holiday-decor rules in the SF office: keep candles battery-powered and no open flames. (posted by @ops)

oliver: EST — this is my ugly ceramic reindeer mug. 2pm toast counts me in. :santa:

devon: (uploads image) "tiny mug, biscuit casualty"

sam: (uploads image) "mocha + cat sitting on keyboard" :joy:

marta: cookie wins so far (3 reactions). also shoutout to @anya for organizing the swap last year, best secret-santa ever. :tada:

li: (uploads image) traveling mug + airport ambience. :airplane:

anya: love these!! quick logistics: if anyone wants to join a timezone-friendly 10-min video toast, react with :clap: and i'll DM a link and times.

oliver: :clap: would join at 2pm EST (which is 7pm UTC?)

devon: counted reactions — cookie 5, biscotti 2. cookie wins. planning a small shelf of assorted treats in SF kitchen Friday for people in-office.

marta: can someone save the pics into the #holiday-photos thread later? would love to make a tiny collage for the newsletter.

anya: yep i'll collect and post. thanks for the enthusiasm, this is the best tiny-office energy. :sparkles:

ops-bot: Heads-up: the SF office will have extended kitchen hours Friday for the holiday treat shelf.

sam: thanks ops! also tagging @marta for cookie recipe swap thread. :yum:

anya: last note — holiday-themed wallpapers exchange? drop link or file and i'll pin.

li: i'll add a minimalist snow pattern i made.

oliver: cheers everyone, timezone toast 2pm EST — see you (virtually) with mugs up! :clinking_glasses:
